name: @repo/ai-sources
description: Favicon stack that fans out on hover and expands into a source list, with each favicon morphing into its row.

useCases: Retrieved chunks in a RAG interface
Compact provenance row under a message
compositionHints: The favicon morphs into its row via a shared layout id — do not re-key it
Collapsed by default; provenance should be available, not loud
Pair with ai-citation for inline references to the same sources
